name: LAC Med Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为常规企业事务，包括公司秘书变更、地址变更、股东大会及股息派发，未披露业务板块的扩张、缩减、新业务或合约信息。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收45,599,000令吉，净利润5,267,000令吉。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements were mainly routine corporate matters, including changes of company secretary, change of address, general meetings and dividend payment, with no disclosure of segment expansion, reduction, new business or contracts. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was RM45,599,000 with net profit of RM5,267,000.
